desc: Ideation and approach selection: separate positive-product and zero-product cases; use product-major bitset DP for positive products and 4-state bitset reachability for zero products.
Implement the zero/positive decomposition solution with early bound, bitset sum encoding, zero-product reachability, exact positive-product DP, and final descending product scan.
Verify sample tests and edge cases (examples, zeros, non-empty k=0, x>limit, product-limit pruning); no failures requiring debug or approach switch.
